Name: Flowering Falls Farm
Author: KristaIsGayAsf
Description:
[color=#e06666][b][i][center][size=5]
[font=Times New Roman]❤❤ Flowering Falls Farm ❤❤[/font][/size][font=Times New Roman]
[size=5]~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
[/size][/font][font=Times New Roman]
[/font][/center][/i][/b][/color][center][font=Times New Roman][size=3]Compatible with 1.6.
Not available for mobile yet.
Supports up to 4 players on co-op. [/size][i][size=2][u](host + 3 additional players)[/u] [u][b][color=#ff0000]ALL PLAYERS MUST HAVE MOD INSTALLED[/color][/b][/u][/size][/i][b]
[/b][size=3]Replaces "Standard" farm.[/size]
[size=3]All grass is diggable and buildable.
Includes a pond, a river, and a waterfall, as well as pre-designed areas for crops and coops/barns.[/size]
[i]Pet bowl has been moved from default spot, would recommend talking to Robin to move it where you'd like though.
Talk to Robin about moving the cabins if you're unhappy with the initial placement of them.
[u]Only works 100% properly when starting a new save. If you try running this mod with a previous save, you run the risk of corrupting your save file.[/u]


[/i][b][u][color=#cc0000][size=4]REQUIREMENTS
[/size][/color][/u][/b][size=3]Requires [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ (minimum version 4.0.4)[/size]
[size=3]Requires [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ (minimum version 2.0.4)[/size]
[size=3]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets[/url] (minimum version 1.9.1)﻿[/size]


[color=#1e84cc][size=4][b][i][u]Installation
[/u][/i][/b][/size][/color][size=3][u]Step 1: Install the latest versions of SMAPI, Content Patcher and DaisyNiko's Tilesheets, then download this mod.
Step 2: Extract the "[CP] Flowering Falls Farm" folder into your Stardew Valley "Mods" folder.
Step 3: Run the game with SMAPI and start a new save file on the "Standard" farm.[/u][/size]


[size=4]Image Information[/size]
[/font][size=3][font=Times New Roman]In the images section I've included vanilla screenshots, as well as modded screenshots.
The visual mods I'm using in these photos include:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1993]Elle's Seasonal Buildings[/url]﻿
[/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20720][font=Times New Roman]Wyrd's Seasonal Mailboxes[/font]
[/url]﻿

[/size][/center]
